actions.name: Ask Hesta about Ash and the missing surveyor
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Ash kept me company after the foundry closed. Give him space, a little food, or that quiet hunter's look. I'll dress your wounds if you need it. But don't strike him in front of me and then ask me to patch you up. The ward blade is still in the valve chamber; fire runs along it, but no steel will turn a steam jet.'
actions.speaker: world__hesta

actions.name: Speak to Hesta after the fight
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Nera keeps a shop in town. I will not stop you leaving, but I won't serve you.'
actions.speaker: world__hesta

actions.name: Lever {rescue__rack} up with {rescue__bar}
actions.report: You get {rescue__bar} under {rescue__rack} and lean on it. It lifts a hand's breadth, and {rescue__guest} drags the leg clear: bruised and cut, but whole.

actions.name: Dig out beneath {rescue__rack} with your hands
actions.report: It takes most of an hour of scraping grit and stone with bare hands. At last {rescue__guest} eases the leg out from under {rescue__rack}.

actions.name: Dig out beneath {rescue__rack}, the way a miner would
actions.report: Twenty minutes of quick, careful digging, shoring as you go. At last {rescue__guest} eases the leg out from under {rescue__rack}.

actions.name: Heave {rescue__rack} off by main force; {lifter} lifts
actions.report: {lifter} gets a shoulder under {rescue__rack} and heaves. It comes up, then the grip slips and it crashes down on its side. {rescue__guest} screams; the leg is broken.

actions.name: Set and bind {rescue__guest}'s broken leg
actions.report: The leg is straightened and splinted between two lengths of wood. {rescue__guest} goes white, then manages to stand.

actions.name: Ask {rescue__relative} what is wrong
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: '{rescue__guest} went up to {world__censer_hill} at first light and should have been back by mid-morning,' says {rescue__relative}. 'Nobody has seen them since. The short way in is {world__culvert}, and {rescue__water} will close it at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}; after that you go the long way round. Please. Go and look.'
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__relative}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: {rescue__relative} takes your hands in both of theirs. 'You brought them back yourselves. I won't forget it.' Six coins are pressed into your palm: everything in the purse.
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__relative}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'They found their own way back, on that leg,' says {rescue__relative}, not quite looking at you. 'You got them out. I'm grateful. But you might have walked them back.' Three coins, counted out carefully.
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Ask how {rescue__guest} is mending
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Grumbling, which is a good sign,' says {rescue__relative}. 'You're welcome at this door any time.'
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what happened
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'It came down on me when I leaned on it,' says {rescue__guest} through their teeth. 'I can't shift it from under. There's {rescue__bar} in {world__stores}, if you can fetch it. Or dig me out, if you've the time. Don't just haul on it; I heard something crack already.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what they mean to do
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Home,' says {rescue__guest}. 'If you're going that way, I'll come with you. If not, I'll manage. I'm not sitting down here another hour.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what they mean to do
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I can't walk on it,' says {rescue__guest}. 'Not alone. Give me an arm and I'll hop the whole way if I have to.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__guest}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I owe you,' says {rescue__guest}. 'Next time I'll leave the old workings to the rats.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

rules.say: The hound's growl fills the gallery. It does not come at you; it holds the hoist passage.
Hesta draws the linen basket to her chest. 'I saw you strike Ash. Find your salve elsewhere.'
{rescue__relative} hurries over to you. 'Are you going up to {world__censer_hill}? Have you seen {rescue__guest}?'
A voice from low down in the dark: 'Here! Over here. Mind {rescue__rack}; it's on my leg. Don't just haul on it. Something cracked when it came down.'
{rescue__water} closes over {world__culvert}. That way is shut now.
{rescue__relative} sees {rescue__guest}, and runs. For a while nobody says anything sensible.
{rescue__guest} limps in and sits down hard by the hearth.

observations.text: A lean cave hound stands across the hoist passage, head low, lips back from its teeth.
The cave hound lies in the mould dust, watching, no longer barring the hoist passage.
A squat bronze inspector turns on stiff joints. Its plated body resists steel and cannot be poisoned. The arch and pipe walk remain open; nothing compels you to fight it.
A split pipe hisses over the boiler arch. Fresh scorch marks stripe the boiler arch; turning its seized valve needs a crowbar. A fire ward can blunt a scald, but the jet must still be crossed.
The pipe's valve is turned hard shut. The boiler arch is clear.
The old pipe has vented its last pressure. Wet stone steams underfoot.
A rusted padlock holds the stores door shut.
The stores door stands open; its padlock hangs from the hasp.

Barges nose into reed-fringed piles. The Serewater is high and brown. Upriver, the derelict foundry on Censer Hill stands above the willows. The Oar's sign creaks over one door, Nera's herbs hang in another, and the shrine porch faces the water.
Dry boots steam above the hearth. Bargemen eat at the long table, and stairs climb to the rooms above.
Bunches of herbs hang from the beams over shelves of jars, coils of rope and wrapped rations.
Two small altars face each other under a low roof. Water-stained name slips are pinned to every beam.
A low kitchen with the tide board nailed by the door and a kettle on the hob.
Old stones run out across the floodplain between willow poles. A track climbs the ridge toward the foundry; a lower path drops into the reeds toward the hill's drain.
Short grass and hawthorn on pale chalk. The foundry yard is just above; Reedwake lies far below.
Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. A roofless arch opens into the upper works.
A broken culvert breathes cold air out of the hillside. Water already runs ankle-deep along its floor.
Lime-washed walls, a fallen lamp bracket, and footprints in the dust heading deeper in.
Half-cast bells lean against the walls. Doorways lead to the stores and the vestibule; steps go down to the casting gallery, and the culvert mouth gapes in the floor.
Collapsed shelving and oilcloth bundles. The far wall is old brick with a low, black opening at its foot.
A wheel valve and a row of cold boilers fill the room. The workshop arch leads back; a narrow pipe walk reaches the casting gallery.
Ceramic moulds stand in rows beneath a broken roof. The far end narrows into the hoist passage.
A slack cable hangs from the hoist drum. Timber and tools lie where a rack came down.
{rescue__guest} lies half under {rescue__rack}, one leg trapped beneath it. Their face is grey with pain and cold.
{rescue__guest} keeps their weight off one leg, but can walk.
{rescue__guest} cannot put any weight on the broken leg.
{rescue__guest} sits with the bad leg up on a stool while {rescue__relative} scolds and feeds them.
{rescue__relative} stands with one hand shading their eyes, watching the way to {world__censer_hill}.
{rescue__relative} keeps a hand on {rescue__guest}'s sleeve, as if they might vanish again.
{rescue__rack} lies across the floor where it fell, wedged against the wall.
{rescue__rack} has been levered up and wedged on a lump of stone; there is space beneath it now.
{rescue__rack} lies where it fell, but a hollow has been scraped out of the floor beneath one end.
{rescue__rack} lies tipped on its side against the wall, one end split where it dropped.
{world__culvert} is still clear, but {rescue__water} will close it at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}.
{rescue__water} has closed {world__culvert}.

objectives.text: {rescue__relative} asked you to find {rescue__guest} in {world__censer_hill}. {rescue__water} closes {world__culvert} at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}.
{rescue__guest} is back with {rescue__relative}, who will want a word with you.

A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.

Barges nose into reed-fringed piles. The Serewater is high and brown. Upriver, the derelict foundry on Censer Hill stands above the willows. The Oar's sign creaks over one door, Nera's herbs hang in another, and the shrine porch faces the water.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
Old stones run out across the floodplain between willow poles. A track climbs the ridge toward the foundry; a lower path drops into the reeds toward the hill's drain.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
Short grass and hawthorn on pale chalk. The foundry yard is just above; Reedwake lies far below.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. A roofless arch opens into the upper works.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
Lime-washed walls, a fallen lamp bracket, and footprints in the dust heading deeper in.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
A split pipe hisses over the boiler arch. Fresh scorch marks stripe the boiler arch; turning its seized valve needs a crowbar. A fire ward can blunt a scald, but the jet must still be crossed.
The stores door stands open; its padlock hangs from the hasp.
Half-cast bells lean against the walls. Doorways lead to the stores and the vestibule; steps go down to the casting gallery, and the culvert mouth gapes in the floor.
The rising river has closed the drain culvert.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.
The hound's growl fills the gallery. It does not come at you; it holds the hoist passage.
A lean cave hound stands across the hoist passage, head low, lips back from its teeth.
Ceramic moulds stand in rows beneath a broken roof. The far end narrows into the hoist passage.
A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board.

events.response: 'Ash kept me company after the foundry closed. Give him space, a little food, or that quiet hunter's look. I'll dress your wounds if you need it. But don't strike him in front of me and then ask me to patch you up. The ward blade is still in the valve chamber; fire runs along it, but no steel will turn a steam jet.'
